operations.summary: Search for people matching criteria

parameters.name: address[]
parameters.description: Requires an person's address to contain this value.

parameters.name: agent_team_id[]
parameters.description: Requires a person to be a member of this agent team.

parameters.name: alpha[]
parameters.description: Requires a person's last name to start with this letter.

parameters.name: date_created_end
parameters.description: Requires a person's account to have been created before this date. Must be specified as a Unix timestamp.

parameters.name: date_created_start
parameters.description: Requires a person's account to have been created after this date. Must be specified as a Unix timestamp.

parameters.name: email[]
parameters.description: Requires a person to have an email that contains this value.

parameters.name: email_domain[]
parameters.description: Requires a person to have an email with a domain that contains this value.

parameters.name: field[#][]
parameters.description: Requires person custom field to have the specified value in the listed field.

parameters.name: im[]
parameters.description: Requires an person to have an instant messenger contact that contains this value.

parameters.name: is_agent
parameters.description: True to search on agents instead of users.

parameters.name: is_agent_confirmed
parameters.description: Requires the person to be confirmed by an agent or not.

parameters.name: label[]
parameters.description: Requires person to be have the specified label.

parameters.name: name[]
parameters.description: Requires an person to have a name that contains this value.

parameters.name: language_id[]
parameters.description: Requires person to have chosen this language.

parameters.name: organization_id[]
parameters.description: Requires person to be a member of this organization.

parameters.name: phone[]
parameters.description: Requires person to have a phone number that contains this value.

parameters.name: usergroup_id[]
parameters.description: Requires person to be a member of this usergroup.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order of the results. Defaults to accessing person's preference or people.id:asc.

parameters.name: cache_id
parameters.description: If provided, cached results from this result set are used. If it cannot be found or used, the other constraints provided will be used to create a new result set.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number of the results to fetch.

operations.notes: Returns list of people that matched.

operations.summary: Creates a new Person.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the Person.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Set the password for the person so they can log in.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Primary email of the person. This cannot already exist.

parameters.name: contact_data[#]
parameters.description: Components of a contact detail to add. See the Setting Contact Data article for more information.

parameters.name: disable_autoresponses
parameters.description: If true, disables sending this person automatic notifications when actions are applied to their tickets.

parameters.name: field[#]
parameters.description: Value for the specified custom person field.

parameters.name: group_id[]
parameters.description: ID of a usergroup to add this person to.

parameters.name: label[]
parameters.description: Label to apply to the person.

parameters.name: is_disabled
parameters.description: If true, sets this person to be disabled (can't login or interact with tickets/chat).

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Name of the organization this person should belong to. If this does not exist, one will be created.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the organization this person should belong to.

parameters.name: organization_position
parameters.description: If the person belongs to an organization, their position within it.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Summary of the person's details.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Olson time zone string identifier.

parameters.name: send_email
parameters.description: Send the user a welcome email (false by default).
